:::{#thm-mvn-density-precision}
#### The multivariate Gaussian density in terms of the precision matrix

If $\vX$ has the [multivariate Gaussian distribution](#def-mvn) $\Normal_p\paren{\vecf{\mean}, \matr{\covmat}}$,
and $\matr{\Lambda} = \precision(\vX)$ is its [precision matrix](#def-precision-matrix),
then $\vX$ has [joint density](random-variables.qmd#def-joint-pdf):

$$
\p(\vX = \vx) =
\frac{\det(\matr{\Lambda})^{1/2}}{(2\pi)^{p/2}}
\ef{-\frac{1}{2} \tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})} \matr{\Lambda} (\vx - \vecf{\mean})},
\quad \vx \in \reals^p.
$$

:::

::: proof

By @thm-precision-matrix-inverse, $\matr{\Lambda} = \inv{\matr{\covmat}}$,
so $\det(\matr{\Lambda}) = 1 / \det(\matr{\covmat})$
(the [determinant](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-determinant) of an [inverse](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-special-matrices.html#def-matrix-inverse) is the reciprocal of the determinant).
Substituting both into the [joint density](random-variables.qmd#def-joint-pdf) of @def-mvn:

$$
\ba
\p(\vX = \vx)
&= \frac{1}{(2\pi)^{p/2} \det(\matr{\covmat})^{1/2}}
\ef{-\frac{1}{2} \tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})} \inv{\matr{\covmat}} (\vx - \vecf{\mean})}
&& \text{(the multivariate Gaussian density)} \\
&= \frac{\det(\matr{\Lambda})^{1/2}}{(2\pi)^{p/2}}
\ef{-\frac{1}{2} \tp{(\vx - \vecf{\mean})} \matr{\Lambda} (\vx - \vecf{\mean})}
&& \text{(substitute } \inv{\matr{\covmat}} = \matr{\Lambda} \text{ and } 1 / \det(\matr{\covmat}) = \det(\matr{\Lambda}) \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
